name: Pizza Kebab House
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizza & Kebap House in Sankt Anton am Arlberg**

---
**Welcome to our cozy spot in the heart of Sankt Anton am Arlberg!**

After a thrilling day on the slopes of the **Arlberg**, enjoy our delicious **Pizza & Kebap**—freshly prepared with love. Whether you crave a crispy **Döner Kebap**, a cheesy **Käsespätzle**, or a classic **Tiroler Gröstl**, we’ve got you covered.

**Try our famous Kaiserschmarrn** for dessert—fluffy, caramelized, and served with fresh fruit or a dollop of vanilla sauce.

**Come by for a quick bite or stay for a meal**—we’re open all day, every day, and just a short walk from the **Rettenbachferner** and **Galzig** lifts.

**Prost & enjoy your stay in Tirol!** 🍕🔥
